note: Per-actor perspective depth-scale for the Scooby-Doo Mystery Godot port. FINDING (VERIFIED): the ROM has NO continuous per-actor, Y-based sprite depth-scale. Genesis VDP sprites cannot be hardware-zoomed, and the OAM-emit path (0xAD16-0xADAC, from 0xACCA) selects all size/piece-layout LUTs by the actor TYPE byte (4(A1)) and a flip bit (10(A1)&8), never by Y. The op-12/sub-command-21 mechanism previously suspected of being depth-scale is actually a SCRIPTED PER-OBJECT position-ease effect, NOT an actor depth scaler and NOT applied per-room. Citations: script opcode-12 handler 0x2E9E (4-byte op: word0=0x000C, word1=subcmd); subcmd jump table (longwords) at 0x2EB4, entry 21 = 0x432C (reserve one of 4 slots =2..5, set enable bit3 of , hand off to VBlank); the per-frame multiply at 0xB52A (inside fn 0xB4BE): out = base - (raw*(255-bound))>>8, per axis, raw = fields 14/16(A0) of a ROM graphics descriptor (A0= base +  offset), bound_x= bound_y= (from 0x71CC geometry interp), base = /, result stored to [slot]/[slot]. CONSUMER of that output: it is a screen POSITION in the SAME array/space as the point-and-click CURSOR (hit-test at 0x12CC reads />>3 to pick actors); there is NO OAM sprite-SIZE write anywhere in this path. sub-21 is always bracketed by sub-22 (0x0016 -> 0x436A) as start/stop of a one-shot cutscene effect. EXECUTED (rung 1, m68k interp entering 0xB524): out=base-(raw*(255-bound))>>8 reproduced exactly for bound 0/128/200 (raw=64,base=300 -> 237/269/287). Only 5 op-12/sub-21 sites exist in the whole 2MB ROM, all inside ITEM/PUZZLE object scripts (hotel Shovel@0x149A08, hotel Pole@0x14EDDC, hotel Medallion@0x14E8FE, carnival Hammer@0x1B9F88) - never in any room/scene stream. Scene 16 (the lobby) contains ZERO opcode-12 ops. THEREFORE: for every room, actor depth-scale is DISABLED and scale(y)=1.0. The lobby rendering Blake/Shaggy/Scooby at flat 1:1 is CORRECT per ROM. The port should REMOVE the uncited lerp(0.55..1.0) curve rather than replace it.

mechanism.kind: scripted one-shot per-object position-ease (item/puzzle cutscenes only)
mechanism.formula: out = base - (raw*(255-bound))>>8  (per axis, 8.8 fixed, MULS signed, ASR arithmetic)
mechanism.output_consumer: [slot]/[slot] = a screen POSITION (cursor-space slot array, hit-test 0x12CC). NO OAM size write.
